key.name: switch
key.summary: Key to switch unlock dialog background extensions

key.name: picture-uri
key.description: URI to use for the background image. Note that the backend only supports local (file://) URIs.

key.name: picture-uri-dark
key.description: URI to use for the background image. Note that the backend only supports local (file://) URIs.

key.name: picture-options
key.description: Determines how the image set by wallpaper_filename is rendered. Possible values are “none”, “wallpaper”, “centered”, “scaled”, “stretched”, “zoom”, “spanned”.

key.name: picture-opacity
key.description: Opacity with which to draw the background picture.

key.name: primary-color
key.description: Left or Top color when drawing gradients, or the solid color.

key.name: secondary-color
key.description: Right or Bottom color when drawing gradients, not used for solid color.

key.name: color-shading-type
key.description: How to shade the background color. Possible values are “horizontal”, “vertical”, and “solid”.

key.name: show-desktop-icons
key.summary: Have file manager handle the desktop
key.description: If set to true, then file manager will draw the icons on the desktop.

key.name: source-mode
key.summary: Where the lock screen picture comes from
key.description: “single” uses single-picture, “folder” picks a random image from folder-path, “unsplash” downloads random photos.

key.name: folder-path
key.summary: Folder to pick random pictures from

key.name: unsplash-url
key.description: A collection, search, user or topic link from unsplash.com, plain search terms, or any direct image URL.

key.name: cache-size
key.summary: How many downloaded pictures to keep on disk

key.name: request-next
key.summary: Bumped by the preferences window to ask for a new picture now

key.name: last-error
key.summary: Last error while fetching a picture
